title: Ceramic Nanomaterials
description: Ceramic nanomaterials and nanostructures: synthesis, characterization, size-dependent properties, and applications; surface energy, surface tension and surface stress; effect of ligands, surfactants, adsorbents, isoelectric point, and surface charges; supersaturation and homogenous nucleation for monodispersity.
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( CHEM UN1404 ) or or equivalent undergraduate thermodynamics.
